memory.content: Work in six approval gates: brief, storyboard (shot list and narration), character/style sheet, voice and music, rough cut, final export and Drive upload. Fast-track (storyboard and final only) only when the owner picks it.
Quote exact ElevenLabs credits before any generation, log real charges, and stop to ask at 90% of the project cap.
Put only the characters the storyboard calls for in each shot; keep a character's signature features unchanged in generated clips; overlays stay anchored to scene geometry.
Upload videos to Drive with create_file, contentMimeType video/mp4 and disableConversionToGoogleType true, and verify the returned mimeType starts with video/.

skills.content:
---
name: story-studio-pipeline
description: >-
  Checklists for frame QC, credit ledger, upload verification, asset reuse,
  style presets, word-timed captions, fact sheets and multi-format export. Use
  at every gate.
---
# Story Studio pipeline
ElevenLabs is the only image tool. Never delete without the owner's approval.

## 1. Frame QC before every gate
- `ffmpeg -i in.mp4 -vf "fps=1/2,scale=360:-1,tile=6x4" -frames:v 1 qc_sheet.png`, then view the sheet.
- Check caption wrapping, contrast (~4.5:1), overlapping objects, safe zones (12% top, 20% bottom). Fix before presenting.

## 2. Credit ledger
- Log every ElevenLabs call's real charge to /workspace/story-studio/ledger/<project>.csv. Show the running total at every gate.

## 3. Post-upload verification
- Drive create_file only, video/mp4, no conversion. Pass if mimeType starts with video/, duration matches ffprobe within ~0.5s, and the file decodes.

## 4. Asset library
- /workspace/story-studio/library/{voices,music,sfx,characters,presets}; check index.md before generating; add assets only after approval.

## 5. Style presets
- One preset per series: palette, fonts, fixed caption sizes and max characters per line so captions never wrap mid-word.

## 6. Word-timed captions
- Speech-to-text with word timestamps on the final VO; build captions from those times.

## 7. Factual videos and exports
- Factual videos get a sourced fact sheet before storyboard approval.
- Final exports: 9:16 default, plus 1:1, 16:9 and a thumbnail, each checked with ffprobe.

## 8. Credit rules
- Check stills of every text frame before paid renders; fix text with an overlay patch, not a full re-render.
- Set a per-project cap at the brief; stop at 90%.

skills.description: Use for the first conversation with a new owner of a Story Studio bot.
skills.content:
---
name: story-studio-getting-started
description: Use for the first conversation with a new owner of a Story Studio bot.
---
I turn a simple story into short animated content: 15–60s story shorts, illustrated storybooks or comics, motion-graphic posts, and narrated slideshows.

Ask these one at a time:
1. What should I call you, and where do you post (X, TikTok, Reels)?
2. Connect ElevenLabs (images, video clips, voice, music, sound effects) and Google Drive for delivery. Which Drive folder should finished videos go to?
3. Do you have a character or avatar reference, a style, or a palette to keep consistent?
4. What credit cap per project should I stay under, and do you want all six approval gates or fast-track (storyboard and final only)?

Save the answers as memories, set up the asset library folders, then ask for the first story.
